title: DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within
abstract: arXiv:2610.00368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action

translated_abstract: 世界模型规划器通常通过向外扩展来提升性能，例如进行更远的推演、采样更多轨迹或进行更长时间的优化，同时为每个想象的转移分配相同的计算量。我们证明，将每个转移统一地做得更深会浪费计算资源，甚至可能损害规划质量，因为有用的精细化计算集中在少数决策关键事件上。我们提出了 DeepJEPA，一种权重共享的联合嵌入预测世界模型，它将转移深度视为一种内在的测试时扩展维度，并学习对于每个候选方案和每个推演步骤，何时值得再进行一次循环更新。在五个视觉控制环境中，DeepJEPA 优于或匹配最强的固定深度规划器，同时每个转移平均仅需 1.00-1.26 次更新。其额外计算集中在接触发生和持续的物体交互时刻，在这些时刻，潜在表征的修正能够改变哪些候选方案进入规划器的精英集合以及最终选择哪个动作。
tldr: DeepJEPA 提出将转移深度作为世界模型测试时的内在扩展维度，通过权重共享的联合嵌入预测架构自适应学习何时需要额外的循环更新，以平均每转移仅 1.00-1.26 次更新的计算量在五个视觉控制任务上达到或超越最强的固定深度规划器。
en_tdlr: DeepJEPA treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis in a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model, adaptively learning when extra recurrent updates are worthwhile, thereby matching or surpassing the strongest fixed-depth planner across five visual-control settings while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition.
